config.selection: Post-hoc diagnosis of all off-catalog endpoints finite-guard violations at sigma=0.020mm. Search every executed nonzero command in these selected trajectories, using ONLY its public prefix and proposed command. Selection uses evaluation outcomes; search does not receive true parameters or true future labels.
config.scope: Standard finite Sobol counterexample search over a continuous parameter box, followed by independent small-increment forward replay. A found feasible violating point is numerical evidence against a finite-catalog allow decision. Failure to find a point is NOT a risk upper bound, an allow decision or a safety certificate. No changes to the earlier executed policies or result tables.
